name: R-spondin 3

function.text: RSPO3 encodes r-spondin-3. Annotated molecular activities include frizzled binding and signaling receptor binding. It participates in sprouting angiogenesis and blood vessel remodeling.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: RSPO3 encodes r-spondin-3. Based in part on similarity, it is an activator of the canonical Wnt signaling pathway by acting as a ligand for LGR4-6 receptors, which acts as a key regulator of angiogenesis. It also regulates the canonical Wnt/beta-catenin-dependent pathway and non-canonical Wnt signaling by acting as an inhibitor of ZNRF3, an important regulator of the Wnt signaling pathway. It functions as a ligand for frizzled FZD8 and LRP6.
